cases.translation: The boy Samuel served before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Светильник Бога еще не догорел, и Самуил лежал в храме ___.
cases.translation: God's lamp had not yet gone out, and Samuel lay in the temple of the Lord.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession: 'the temple of the Lord'.

cases.sentence: Господь позвал Самуила, и Самуил ответил, «Вот я» - и подбежал к ___.
cases.translation: The Lord called Samuel, who ran to Eli.
cases.explain: Motion toward a person (к) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Илий понял, что мальчика зовет ___.
cases.translation: Then Eli understood that the Lord was calling the child.
cases.explain: The Lord is the subject of the verb зовет (is calling), requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: Samuel did not yet know the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb знать (to know) takes the accusative in modern Russian, but genitive is used here in this biblical translation.
The verb слушает (hears/listens to) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я собираюсь совершить в Израиле такое, отчего у каждого, кто услышит об этом, зазвенит в ___.
cases.translation: I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears it tingle.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) takes the prepositional case for location.

cases.sentence: Весь Израиль от Дана до Версавии признал, что Самуил — истинный пророк ___.
cases.translation: All Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was a true prophet of the Lord.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession or relationship: 'prophet of the Lord'.

reading.ru: В те дни слово Господа было редким, нечасты были и видения.
reading.question: What was rare during the time Samuel was a boy?
reading.explain: The text states that God's word was rare and visions were uncommon in those days.

reading.ru: Как-то ночью Илий, чьи глаза ослабели настолько, что он едва мог видеть, лежал на своем обычном месте.
reading.question: What condition did Eli suffer from?
reading.explain: The text says his eyes had become so dim that he could barely see.

reading.ru: Самуил не знал еще Господа, слово Господа еще не открывалось ему.
reading.question: What did the text reveal about Samuel's knowledge at this time?
options: He did not yet know the Lord; God's word had not been revealed to him
He knew God but had never heard His voice
He was afraid of God's word
He refused to listen to God
reading.correct: He did not yet know the Lord; God's word had not been revealed to him
reading.explain: The passage explicitly states Samuel did not know the Lord and God's word had not been revealed to him.

reading.ru: Иди и ложись, и если он позовет тебя, скажи, «Говори, Господи, твой слуга слушает тебя».
reading.question: What did Eli instruct Samuel to say if called again?
options: Speak, Lord; your servant is listening
What do you want from me, Lord?
reading.correct: Speak, Lord; your servant is listening
reading.explain: Eli told Samuel to say 'Speak, Lord; your servant hears you.'

reading.ru: Господь был Самуилом, когда тот вырос, и не оставил несбывшимся ни одного из его слов.
reading.question: What happened to Samuel's words as he grew?
options: The Lord was with him and did not let any of his words fail
reading.correct: The Lord was with him and did not let any of his words fail
reading.explain: The text states God was with Samuel and did not let any of his words fall to the ground.

reading.ru: Весь Израиль от Дана до Версавии признал, что Самуил — истинный пророк Господа.
reading.question: How widely was Samuel recognized as a prophet?
options: Throughout all Israel from Dan to Beersheba
reading.correct: Throughout all Israel from Dan to Beersheba
reading.explain: All Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized Samuel as a true prophet of the Lord.
